about_company.about_short: Builds high-reliability electronics for defence, aerospace, industrial and medical customers.
about_company.business_intro: Vinyas is an electronics manufacturing services provider for mission-critical, high-mix programmes. It earns revenue by assembling printed circuit boards, integrating systems and subsystems, building cable harnesses and supporting products through their lifecycle for OEMs, Tier-1 suppliers and defence customers.
about_company.about_long: Vinyas manufactures electronics for defence and aerospace, industrial, medical and transportation applications. Its work spans build-to-print PCB assembly, electro-mechanical integration, cable harnesses, functional testing and lifecycle support. Defence and aerospace are the largest end-markets, while management is adding system-integration work and qualifying for commercial aerospace, medical and export-controlled programmes.

business_facts.title: How it earns
business_facts.text: Vinyas provides PCB assembly, system-level manufacturing, subsystem integration and lifecycle support. It works on long-cycle, high-reliability programmes for global OEMs, Tier-1 suppliers and Indian defence customers rather than mass-market consumer electronics.

business_facts.title: End-market mix
business_facts.text: Defence and aerospace contributed 78.5% of H1 FY26 operating revenue, industrial electronics 18.5%, medical 1.3% and other businesses 1.7%. These are end-market shares, not export shares.

business_facts.title: Manufacturing base
business_facts.text: The company reports one 150,000 sq ft manufacturing unit in Mysuru and a team of 408. The site supports printed-board assembly, cable harnesses, electro-mechanical work, functional testing and system integration.

business_facts.title: Quality credentials
business_facts.text: Certifications disclosed include NADCAP AC7120 for electronics printed-board assemblies, AS9100-D for aerospace, IATF 16949 for automotive and ISO 13485 for medical devices. NADCAP enables qualification for programmes that require that accreditation; it does not itself represent an order.

business_facts.title: Order book
business_facts.text: The order book was ₹1,062 crore at 30 September 2025. Management said a large portion came from defence and aerospace requirements; the investor presentation assigns ₹727 crore to the defence and aerospace programme pipeline and ₹290 crore to system-integration work.

business_facts.title: Capital raised for scale-up
business_facts.text: Vinyas raised ₹150.04 crore through a preferential issue in September 2025. Management said the proceeds were intended mainly for working capital and capacity expansion; new capacity was expected to require customer qualification before contributing fully.

what_changed.headline: The mix is broadening beyond defence assembly.
what_changed.text: Industrial electronics rose from 10.7% of FY24 operating revenue to 18.4% in FY25 and 18.5% in H1 FY26. Vinyas also says it has moved from PCB assembly into qualified system integration, commissioned a medical-device line and entered the commercial-aerospace supply chain; these newer verticals remain much smaller than defence and aerospace.
